units.text: The WHO African Region accounted for 75% of global malaria cases in 2024 is contradicted; sources report 95% (span 6), 94% (span 21, 303) or 94% (span 87). The claim of 75% is unsupported as written.

citations.title: Malaria facts & statistics 2025 | Medicines for Malaria Venture
The burden of malaria in East Africa: prevalence, risk factors, and control strategies

judgement.reason: The passages state the WHO African Region accounted for 95% (2024) or 94% of global malaria cases, directly contradicting a 75% claim; the only 75% figure refers to child malaria deaths, not cases.
